newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sanyo Electric shares jump on upgrading.
newsitem.headline: Sanyo Electric shares jump on upgrading.

text.p: Shares in Sanyo Electric Co jumped on Thursday morning, helped by Nomura Research Institute's upgrading of the electric maker.
Sanyo's shares were up 50 yen at 500 yen at 0051 GMT, and ranked as the top percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Volume was about 1.41 million shares.
On Thursday, Nomura Research Institute upgraded Sanyo to a "1" from its previous "2".

In its three-grade rating system, the research institute assigns a "1" rating to issues whose values it expects to outperform the key 225-share Nikkei average by more than 10 percentage points over the following six months.
Nomura Securities Co Ltd said the research institute expects Sanyo shares to rebound after they had been oversold recently.
